items.title: Disney (DIS) Stock May Trade Near Fair Value On CTO Appointment
items.summary: Walt Disney has been reshaping its streaming and technology footprint, while the share price has lagged over several time frames. This puts the focus squarely on what the current valuation implies about its cash flows. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view available, the question now is whether the cash the business can generate over time lines up with where the stock trades today.
